COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No.1450 of 2024
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. M.S. Bisht, learned counsel 
for the petitioners.
2. Mr. Yogesh Chandra Tiwari, 
learned Standing Counsel for the 
State.
3. Respondent nos.1, 2 and 3 
preferred a suit for permanent 
injunction against the 16 defendants 
in which the petitioner nos. 1 and 2 
are the defendant nos. 12 and 13 and 
rest of the performa respondents 
herein are the rest of the defendants in 
the said suit.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners 
submits that on 21.09.2022, the 
application moved under Section 39 (1) 
(2) of CPC was allowed by allowing the 
application 6C2. Subsequently, an
application was moved by the 
defendant nos.12 and 13, who are the 
petitioners herein on which the order 
dated 21.09.2022 was modified by 
order dated 14.12.2023, whereby the 
earlier order dated 21.09.2022 was 
modified and the status quo was 
confined to only the rest of the 
defendants except the defendant 
nos.12 and 13. Against the order dated 
14.12.2023 passed by the Additional 
District Judge, Rishikesh, the plaintiff 
filed a Miscellaneous Civil Appeal No. 
02 of 2024 ‘Manisha Sharma versus  Virendra Singh Gusain and others’, 
wherein the order dated 14.12.2023 
was set aside and being aggrieved with 
the same, the present writ petition has 
been preferred.
5. Learned counsel for the 
petitioners submits that the petitioners
(defendant Nos.12 and 13) are the 
bonafide purchasers, which has 
nothing to do with the property which 
is subject matter of the suit in￾question.
6. He further submits that the 
names of the petitioners were mutated 
in the Revenue Record. Relevant 
extract of the revenue record is also 
enclosed as Annexure No.3.
7. Issue notice to respondent nos.1, 
2 and 3.
8. Learned counsel for the 
petitioners shall take steps to serve 
respondents within a week returnable 
within three weeks.
9. For rest of the performa 
respondents, there is no need to issue 
notices, since they are the performa 
respondents.
10. The respondents may file 
counter-affidavit within four weeks.
11. Put up this matter on 
22.07.2024.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 18.06.2024
R.Bisht
